Name: JavascriptReportInit
Content:

function load$GridReport$(g) {g.add_onRender(on$GridReport$Render);}
function dispose$GridReport$(g) {try {g.remove_onRender(on$GridReport$Render);} catch (ex) {}}
function on$GridReport$Render(sender, eventArgs) {
  var g = eventArgs.grid;  
  if (g._hiddenFields) {
    var a = g._hiddenFields, h = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      setGridHiddenFields(g, a[i].Fields, a[i].Value);
      if (a[i].Value) h += (h == '' ? '' : ',') + a[i].Fields;
    }
    g._externalHiddenFields = h;
  }
}
function setGridHiddenFields(g, c, v) {
  var a = c.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a[i]));
    if (l != -1) g._setColumnVisible(l, !v);
  }
}
function beforeDrillDown(g) {g._args.cancelEvent = !($func.trim(g._getItemValue(g._activeRow, g._activeColumn)));}

    select '' as field, case when @@language = 'v' then N'Thông tin mã vùng của kho hàng hiện không giống với phiếu nhu cầu.' else N'Site should have same plant as Purchase Requisition.' end as message

    select distinct p into #p from #stt_rec
    while exists(select 1 from #p) begin

select @purOrg = ma_bp0 from @@master where stt_rec = @stt_rec
exec FastBusiness$BI$Structure$Check @purOrg, '', '', '01', @@id, @@unit, @@language, 'New', @@userID, @@admin, '@@sysDatabaseName', @e$Field output, @e$Message output
if isnull(@e$Message, '') <> '' begin
  select @e$Field as field, @e$Message as message
  return
end
